describes: packages/plugin/stage: the page-registry refit, the actions executors and page-state feed, and the pan handler on the interaction hub.

cases.name: page-mutations-refit
cases.covers: A page-registry event bumps the document revision and the effect refits: the rotated footprint re-resolves the zoom intent and the anchor holds; before placement the refit is a no-op.

cases.name: navigation-executors
cases.covers: The default lens registers goto and named executors with actions: goto reveals the destination smoothly (failed when the page is gone), NextPage/PrevPage/FirstPage/LastPage navigate, and any other name is inert.

nodes.detail: no stage or destination page available

diagnostics.message: goto: no stage or destination page available

cases.name: page-state-feed
cases.covers: The default lens feeds actions a page-state report on placement and whenever the current pon or the visible pon set changes (not on a cause flip alone); a page open trigger it causes runs a navigation executor, whose report is programmatic.

cases.name: a-thumbnail-lens-stays-out
cases.covers: A lens with its own id registers no executors and feeds no page state, so actions only ever drive the main lens.

cases.name: pan-handler
cases.covers: The scroll handler pans under the pan tool anywhere (closed-hand cursor while dragging, released on up); under another tool it captures only gap downs, declines page downs, and shows the open hand over gaps on hover.

cases.name: pan-handler-without-fallback
cases.covers: With panFallback off the handler is enabled only for scroll tools: gap drags under the pointer tool do nothing and hovering claims no cursor.
